projection_scope: Read-only projection of the accepted frozen candidate definitions/parameters/invariants/boundaries for calibration. Authoritative source remains PR #536 frozen candidate_set_sha256.

candidates.name: CUT-XOR
candidates.native_idea: N0-definable occupied/contact cut with XOR-local toggle algebra.
candidates.scale_refinement_semantics: toggle count t is N1 horizon, not distance
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: finite toggle words; XOR homomorphism; exact disjoint-union factorization
candidates.finite_information_cost: |V|+|E| bits if B materialized; event cost deg(v)
internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: cut cannot distinguish changes by unions of whole connected components

candidates.name: RELATIONAL-REFINEMENT
candidates.native_idea: Root-free recursive partition refinement by finite contact-neighbor signatures.
candidates.state_carrier: partition P_t of V; numeric label IDs are I0 only
candidates.local_or_update_law: P0=occupancy classes; v~_{t+1}w iff v~_t w and multisets of P_t-neighbor classes agree.
candidates.scale_refinement_semantics: t is N1 refinement horizon; fixed point P* terminates process
invariants: all occupancy/contact automorphisms preserve every Pt
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: iterate to P*; exact restriction to disjoint components up to shared signature names
candidates.finite_information_cost: O(|V|) class IDs plus finite neighbor multisets per round
internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: stable classes may contain genuinely distinct cells/states

candidates.name: CONTACT-PARITY-PROPAGATOR
candidates.native_idea: One-bit N1 state with frozen contact-parity update T(x)(v)=x(v)+Σ_{u~v}x(u) mod 2.
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: powers, XOR superposition, block-diagonal disjoint-union factorization

candidates.name: BRANCH-RECOALESCE
candidates.native_idea: Branch over every contact-adjacent one-cell addition and recoalesce equal reached occupancy states.
candidates.state_carrier: exact multiplicity map m_k(A)∈N; support S_k={A:m_k(A)>0}
candidates.local_or_update_law: A→A∪{v} iff v∉A and v contacts A; m_{k+1}(B)=Σ_{A→B}m_k(A).
candidates.collapse_quotient_support_semantics: histories quotient only by equality of reached A
invariants: on G1⊔G2: graded support product; multiplicity factor C(k,i)
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: level recursion; graded disjoint-union product; idempotent recoalescence
candidates.finite_information_cost: finite each k but worst-case exponentially many supports; multiplicity integers exact
internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: dense E can cause combinatorial explosion

candidates.name: AUTOMORPHISM-ORBIT-COLLAPSE
candidates.native_idea: Choice-free N2 quotient by all exact automorphisms, retaining orbit sizes and inter-orbit contact counts.
candidates.state_carrier: full (V,E,A) remains authoritative; Q is compressed residual
candidates.local_or_update_law: after any finite edit, recompute full Aut(V,E,A), its orbits, sizes, and contact counts.
candidates.collapse_quotient_support_semantics: v~w iff some exact automorphism sends v to w
invariants: Q nonfaithful: C6 and 2K3 both give one orbit of size6 with 6 internal contacts
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: recomputable after edits; not additive when isomorphic components are exchangeable
candidates.finite_information_cost: finite; output may compress strongly; exact Aut computation may be expensive

candidates.name: INCIDENCE-BALANCE-FLOW
candidates.native_idea: Integer N1 charge redistribution along every incident contact with exact total-charge conservation.
candidates.local_or_update_law: legal if deg(v)>0,q(v)≥deg(v); firing subtracts deg(v) at v and adds 1 to each neighbor.
invariants: same legal firing-count vector ⇒ same final q
candidates.recursive_or_composition_behavior: finite firing words; exact disconnected-component factorization
candidates.finite_information_cost: one finite integer/cell; fixed total charge makes reachable set finite
internal_counterexamples_or_degeneracies: no terminal theorem without extra semantics
